_about: Built by tools/build_harvest_finds.py from tools/harvest_finds_content.py; read by world/harvest_finds.py. docs/harvest_finds_design.md.

starters.name: Ticking Copper Nugget
starters.desc: A nugget of copper that's warm in your hand. Hold it still and you can feel it tick, slow and even, like something asleep.

starters.name: Tin Ore With a Fossil Tooth
starters.desc: A lump of tin ore with a tooth sunk in it, long and serrated and longer than your hand. Whatever it came out of was big, and it was hungry a very long time ago.

starters.name: Singing Mithril Shard
starters.desc: A shard of mithril ore that hums one clear note when you hold it, and a lower one answers when you hold it near another stone.

starters.name: Thorium With a Fingerprint
starters.desc: A chunk of thorium ore with one glassy face, and pressed into the glass, a fingerprint. A human one, small and clear, as if someone touched the ore while it was still molten.

starters.name: Mutated Silverleaf
starters.desc: A sprig of silverleaf with one leaf too many, growing out of the stem where no leaf should be. The veins in it are purple.

starters.name: Kingsblood That Bleeds
starters.desc: A kingsblood flower cut at the stem. The stem bleeds slow red drops that don't dry, and it's warm the way a hand is warm.

starters.name: Fadeleaf That Won't Fade
starters.desc: Fadeleaf turns see-through within an hour of picking. This one went half clear and then stopped, as if it got stuck partway.

starters.name: Dreamfoil That Dreams
starters.desc: A sprig of dreamfoil whose leaves curl closed like eyelids. Hold it close and you'd swear it's breathing slowly, the way a sleeper does.

starters.name: Hide With a Map Scratched In
starters.desc: A scrap of hide with a map scratched into the underside: a crooked path, a rock shaped like a tusk, and an X.

starters.name: Tagged Ear
starters.desc: A beast's ear with a bright yellow tag clipped through it, smooth and hard and printed with numbers. It's the kind of tag they put on animals on Earth to follow where they go.

starters.name: Scale From Something Bigger
starters.desc: One scale, dark green with a bronze edge, as big as a shield and heavier than it looks. It came off a beast that was carrying it the way you'd carry a borrowed coat.

starters.name: Stitched Hide
starters.desc: A patch of hide made of two animals' skins, stitched together with black thread while both were still alive. The stitches are neat. Somebody took care.

starters.name: Message in a Bottle
starters.desc: A green glass bottle crusted with barnacles. There's a rolled note inside, and the cork's sealed with candle wax by somebody who meant it to last.

starters.name: Waterlogged Phone
starters.desc: A phone from Earth, its screen cracked across and full of water, with a strand of seaweed caught in the case. It hasn't had a signal in three years and it never will.

starters.name: Kelp-Wrapped Journal
starters.desc: A sailor's journal wrapped in kelp and tied with rope, swollen with seawater. The last pages are dry, as if somebody wrapped it carefully before it went into the sea.

starters.name: Rubber Duck Named Mo
starters.desc: A small yellow rubber duck, faded almost white on top. Tied round its neck on a bit of string is a tag, and on the tag in marker it says MO.

earth_junk.name: Car Keys
earth_junk.desc: A ring of car keys with a plastic charm on it. Somewhere on Earth there's a car nobody's going to drive again.

earth_junk.name: Single Flip-Flop
earth_junk.desc: One blue rubber flip-flop. The other one's out there somewhere, still looking.

earth_junk.name: Cracked Sunglasses
earth_junk.desc: Dark glasses with one lens cracked. They make the world look like a very old photograph.

earth_junk.name: Dented Soda Can
earth_junk.desc: A faded red can, empty, dented on one side. It still fizzes faintly when you shake it, which shouldn't be possible.

earth_junk.name: Stopped Wristwatch
earth_junk.desc: A steel watch with a cracked face. Its hands stopped at the minute of the Integration, like every watch that came through.

earth_junk.name: Waterlogged Tennis Ball
earth_junk.desc: A fuzzy ball gone heavy with water. A dog would still love it.

earth_junk.name: Chipped Coffee Mug
earth_junk.desc: A white mug with a chip in the rim. Someone drank from it every morning for years, you can tell.

earth_junk.name: TV Remote
earth_junk.desc: A black remote with rubber buttons. You press one out of habit, and nothing in the world changes channel.

earth_junk.name: Algae-Covered Garden Gnome
earth_junk.desc: A garden gnome with a red hat and a lot of algae. It's been underwater for a while and it's still smiling.

earth_junk.name: Plastic Toy Dinosaur
earth_junk.desc: A small green plastic dinosaur. The bonehunters in the Barrens would argue about it for a week.

salvage.name: Barnacled Lockbox
salvage.desc: A small iron-bound box crusted with barnacles. The lock rusted shut long ago and the merchants pay for it unopened.

salvage.name: Sodden Coin Purse
salvage.desc: A leather purse heavy with seawater and a few coins. A merchant will take it off your hands, coins and all.

salvage.name: Leaking Goblin Canister
salvage.desc: A dented goblin fuel canister leaking a rainbow slick. Somebody in Ratchet will want the fuel back.

salvage.name: Waterlogged Wreck Crate
salvage.desc: A broken crate from a wreck, rope still knotted round it. Salvage merchants buy these by the pound.

fish_gear.name: Barnacled Signet
fish_gear.flavor_text: A signet ring crusted with tiny barnacles. Whoever wore it last wore it for a long time underwater.

fish_gear.name: Net-Woven Cloak
fish_gear.flavor_text: A cloak knotted from fishing net and lined with sailcloth. It dries faster than it has any right to.

fish_gear.name: Kelpweave Sash
fish_gear.flavor_text: A sash woven from dried kelp. It smells of the sea and it never quite stops being damp.

fish_gear.name: Tidewalker Boots
fish_gear.flavor_text: Sealskin boots from a wreck, tar-stitched at every seam. Water rolls off them like they're offended by it.

fish_gear.name: Saltcrust Bracers
fish_gear.flavor_text: Mail bracers with salt grown into every ring. They creak like a ship at anchor.

fish_gear.name: Anchorline Girdle
fish_gear.flavor_text: A plate girdle with a length of anchor chain worked into its buckle. It holds you where you stand.

fish_gear.name: Drowned Bell Pendant
fish_gear.flavor_text: A ship's bell no bigger than a thumb, still ringing faintly. Sailors say you only hear it when you're about to be saved.

fish_gear.name: Captain's Lost Cutlass
fish_gear.flavor_text: A cutlass from the bottom of the sea, its hilt wrapped in sharkskin. Its captain went down holding it.
